hyperedges.label: Systemic Verification Gap
hyperedges.description: Three interconnected bugs form a systemic gap: verifier trusts text output (Issue 3), executors produce reports not code due to oversize tasks (Issue 4), and no automated post-execution artifact check exists (Issue 5). Together these allow the system to PASS verification with 0 files created.

hyperedges.label: Model Routing Fragility
hyperedges.description: Three bugs in the model routing subsystem: routing check uses agent-name not phase (Issue 1), intake normalizer applies first-found alias and never overrides with more specific role-model pairings (Issue 2), and the GPT-5.5 regex has false-match risk with 'PT 5.5' text (Issue 7). The routing layer is fragile to both natural planner behavior and user intent.

hyperedges.label: ENAMETOOLONG Fix Chain
hyperedges.description: The ENAMETOOLONG regression was caused by stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe'] blocking stdin delivery for large prompts. Three fix options were evaluated (--prompt-file, placeholder+stdin, tempfile+stdin). The applied fix uses pipeStdin + stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'] to write/end child.stdin with the full task. Validated with 16831-char reviewer prompt via fake Pi CLI.

hyperedges.label: Orchestration Failure Cascade
hyperedges.description: The orchestration failure cascade: Issue 1 forces planner to burn 2 attempts working around routing check (11 subagent spawns wasted). Issue 4 causes oversize tasks that saturate executor context, producing reports instead of code. Issue 3 causes verifier to trust those text reports. Issue 5 has no file-level check. Result: 18 subagents, 3 attempts, 1 hour, 0 files — and a PASS verdict.

hyperedges.label: Subagent Process Lifecycle Events
hyperedges.description: Subagent process lifecycle: agent_end signals task completion, but message_end with stopReason=error can arrive after agent_end during internal shutdown. The agentEnded flag fix ignores post-agent_end message_end errors, preventing false fatal crashes. Implemented in spawnSubagent() in substrate.ts.

hyperedges.label: Intake Contract Processing System
hyperedges.description: The intake contract normalizer processes user task text through a pipeline: inferModelRoutingFromTask scans for model mentions, modelAliasFromText matches via regex, applyRoutingAlias maps to roles. The first-found alias wins with no role-specific override, and the resulting contract becomes the governing specification — even when it contradicts user intent. All components reside in src/index.ts.

hyperedges.label: Hard Blocker Triad — Three problems that together made Pi unusable
hyperedges.description: Three independent hard blockers that compounded: overlay blocking input, no cleanup on session_start, and findActiveRunDir treating missing state as active. Together they created an auto-showing modal overlay on every Pi launch.

hyperedges.label: Design Issue Quad — Four reliability problems in widget implementation
hyperedges.description: Four design issues that would cause dashboard unreliability: no widget clearing, unreliable setTimeout cleanup, poor placement defaults, and jiti cache preventing hot-reload of fixes.

hyperedges.label: Orchestrator Reliability Quad — Four systemic orchestration bugs
hyperedges.description: Four orchestration reliability issues: verifier trusts text output not artifacts, executor tasks too large producing reports not code, routing check uses agent name not model/provider, and intake normalizer overrides user model preferences.

hyperedges.label: Dashboard Helper Functions — Inline functions for widget lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Set of inline helper functions that together manage the dashboard widget lifecycle: state creation, progress parsing, line rendering, and status display, all working on DashboardState.

hyperedges.label: Compounding Failure Stack — Three independent problems stacked
hyperedges.description: The compounding failure: panel overlay blocked input (bug), stale run directory with missing completed field kept overlay active, and jiti cache served broken code even after source fixes. Three independent problems in superposition.

hyperedges.label: Critical Fixes Triad — Three essential fixes for dashboard viability
hyperedges.description: Three critical fixes that together make the dashboard viable: use setWidget instead of overlay, guarantee cleanup via finally blocks, and keep dashboard inline in the command handler instead of a separate extension.

Orchestration Safety Parameter System (11 guardrails)
hyperedges.description: 11 interconnected safety guardrails added to composable-pipeline and index.ts to prevent empty-run failures. Includes: prompt truncation (8K cap with proportional split), output type contracts, escape clause scanning/rewriting (9 patterns), budget estimation with >60% warning, 4-signal exhaustion detection, per-agent bug reporting, fallback model retry, 200-word task cap, git-status artifact evidence, and hard gate on zero-file-change implementation runs.

hyperedges.label: Safety Features Covering HANDOFF.md Orchestration Bugs
hyperedges.description: New orchestration safety parameters directly address 4 of 7 HANDOFF.md issues: ISSUE-3 (verifier trusts text) via output contract + artifact evidence + hard gate + phase bug reporting; ISSUE-4 (tasks too large) via task cap + prompt truncation + budget estimation + escape clause scanning + exhaustion detection; ISSUE-5 (no artifact verification) via artifact evidence + hard gate; ISSUE-6 (subagent post-agent_end errors) via fallback model. ISSUE-1 (routing fights planner), ISSUE-2 (intake overrides user model), and ISSUE-7 (PT 5.5 false match) remain unaddressed by these safety additions.

hyperedges.label: Composable Pipeline Safety Architecture
hyperedges.description: The composable-pipeline shape integrates 8 safety guardrails through 4 functions and 2 constants: detectExhaustion (4-signal context check), scanEscapeClauses + rewriteEscapeClauses (9-pattern escape removal), buildExecutorPrompt (output type contracts + escape rewriting + ANTI-ESCAPE NOTE + guardrails), task-size cap (200 words), fallback model (deepseek-v4-pro).

hyperedges.label: Systemic Verification Gap
hyperedges.description: Three interconnected bugs form a systemic gap: verifier trusts text output (Issue 3), executors produce reports not code due to oversize tasks (Issue 4), and no automated post-execution artifact check exists (Issue 5). Together these allow the system to PASS verification with 0 files created.

hyperedges.label: Model Routing Fragility
hyperedges.description: Three bugs in the model routing subsystem: routing check uses agent-name not phase (Issue 1), intake normalizer applies first-found alias and never overrides with more specific role-model pairings (Issue 2), and the GPT-5.5 regex has false-match risk with 'PT 5.5' text (Issue 7). The routing layer is fragile to both natural planner behavior and user intent.

hyperedges.label: ENAMETOOLONG Fix Chain
hyperedges.description: The ENAMETOOLONG regression was caused by stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe'] blocking stdin delivery for large prompts. Three fix options were evaluated (--prompt-file, placeholder+stdin, tempfile+stdin). The applied fix uses pipeStdin + stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'] to write/end child.stdin with the full task. Validated with 16831-char reviewer prompt via fake Pi CLI.

hyperedges.label: Orchestration Failure Cascade
hyperedges.description: The orchestration failure cascade: Issue 1 forces planner to burn 2 attempts working around routing check (11 subagent spawns wasted). Issue 4 causes oversize tasks that saturate executor context, producing reports instead of code. Issue 3 causes verifier to trust those text reports. Issue 5 has no file-level check. Result: 18 subagents, 3 attempts, 1 hour, 0 files — and a PASS verdict.

hyperedges.label: Subagent Process Lifecycle Events
hyperedges.description: Subagent process lifecycle: agent_end signals task completion, but message_end with stopReason=error can arrive after agent_end during internal shutdown. The agentEnded flag fix ignores post-agent_end message_end errors, preventing false fatal crashes. Implemented in spawnSubagent() in substrate.ts.

hyperedges.label: Intake Contract Processing System
hyperedges.description: The intake contract normalizer processes user task text through a pipeline: inferModelRoutingFromTask scans for model mentions, modelAliasFromText matches via regex, applyRoutingAlias maps to roles. The first-found alias wins with no role-specific override, and the resulting contract becomes the governing specification — even when it contradicts user intent. All components reside in src/index.ts.

hyperedges.label: Hard Blocker Triad — Three problems that together made Pi unusable
hyperedges.description: Three independent hard blockers that compounded: overlay blocking input, no cleanup on session_start, and findActiveRunDir treating missing state as active. Together they created an auto-showing modal overlay on every Pi launch.

hyperedges.label: Design Issue Quad — Four reliability problems in widget implementation
hyperedges.description: Four design issues that would cause dashboard unreliability: no widget clearing, unreliable setTimeout cleanup, poor placement defaults, and jiti cache preventing hot-reload of fixes.

hyperedges.label: Orchestrator Reliability Quad — Four systemic orchestration bugs
hyperedges.description: Four orchestration reliability issues: verifier trusts text output not artifacts, executor tasks too large producing reports not code, routing check uses agent name not model/provider, and intake normalizer overrides user model preferences.

hyperedges.label: Dashboard Helper Functions — Inline functions for widget lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Set of inline helper functions that together manage the dashboard widget lifecycle: state creation, progress parsing, line rendering, and status display, all working on DashboardState.

hyperedges.label: Compounding Failure Stack — Three independent problems stacked
hyperedges.description: The compounding failure: panel overlay blocked input (bug), stale run directory with missing completed field kept overlay active, and jiti cache served broken code even after source fixes. Three independent problems in superposition.

hyperedges.label: Critical Fixes Triad — Three essential fixes for dashboard viability
hyperedges.description: Three critical fixes that together make the dashboard viable: use setWidget instead of overlay, guarantee cleanup via finally blocks, and keep dashboard inline in the command handler instead of a separate extension.

Systemic Verification Gap
hyperedges.description: Three interconnected bugs form a systemic gap: verifier trusts text output (Issue 3), executors produce reports not code due to oversize tasks (Issue 4), and no automated post-execution artifact check exists (Issue 5). Together these allow the system to PASS verification with 0 files created.

hyperedges.label: Model Routing Fragility
hyperedges.description: Three bugs in the model routing subsystem: routing check uses agent-name not phase (Issue 1), intake normalizer applies first-found alias and never overrides with more specific role-model pairings (Issue 2), and the GPT-5.5 regex has false-match risk with 'PT 5.5' text (Issue 7). The routing layer is fragile to both natural planner behavior and user intent.

hyperedges.label: ENAMETOOLONG Fix Chain
hyperedges.description: The ENAMETOOLONG regression was caused by stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe'] blocking stdin delivery for large prompts. Three fix options were evaluated (--prompt-file, placeholder+stdin, tempfile+stdin). The applied fix uses pipeStdin + stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe'] to write/end child.stdin with the full task. Validated with 16831-char reviewer prompt via fake Pi CLI.

hyperedges.label: Orchestration Failure Cascade
hyperedges.description: The orchestration failure cascade: Issue 1 forces planner to burn 2 attempts working around routing check (11 subagent spawns wasted). Issue 4 causes oversize tasks that saturate executor context, producing reports instead of code. Issue 3 causes verifier to trust those text reports. Issue 5 has no file-level check. Result: 18 subagents, 3 attempts, 1 hour, 0 files — and a PASS verdict.

hyperedges.label: Subagent Process Lifecycle Events
hyperedges.description: Subagent process lifecycle: agent_end signals task completion, but message_end with stopReason=error can arrive after agent_end during internal shutdown. The agentEnded flag fix ignores post-agent_end message_end errors, preventing false fatal crashes. Implemented in spawnSubagent() in substrate.ts.

hyperedges.label: Intake Contract Processing System
hyperedges.description: The intake contract normalizer processes user task text through a pipeline: inferModelRoutingFromTask scans for model mentions, modelAliasFromText matches via regex, applyRoutingAlias maps to roles. The first-found alias wins with no role-specific override, and the resulting contract becomes the governing specification — even when it contradicts user intent. All components reside in src/index.ts.

hyperedges.label: Hard Blocker Triad — Three problems that together made Pi unusable
hyperedges.description: Three independent hard blockers that compounded: overlay blocking input, no cleanup on session_start, and findActiveRunDir treating missing state as active. Together they created an auto-showing modal overlay on every Pi launch.

hyperedges.label: Design Issue Quad — Four reliability problems in widget implementation
hyperedges.description: Four design issues that would cause dashboard unreliability: no widget clearing, unreliable setTimeout cleanup, poor placement defaults, and jiti cache preventing hot-reload of fixes.

hyperedges.label: Orchestrator Reliability Quad — Four systemic orchestration bugs
hyperedges.description: Four orchestration reliability issues: verifier trusts text output not artifacts, executor tasks too large producing reports not code, routing check uses agent name not model/provider, and intake normalizer overrides user model preferences.

hyperedges.label: Dashboard Helper Functions — Inline functions for widget lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Set of inline helper functions that together manage the dashboard widget lifecycle: state creation, progress parsing, line rendering, and status display, all working on DashboardState.

hyperedges.label: Compounding Failure Stack — Three independent problems stacked
hyperedges.description: The compounding failure: panel overlay blocked input (bug), stale run directory with missing completed field kept overlay active, and jiti cache served broken code even after source fixes. Three independent problems in superposition.

hyperedges.label: Critical Fixes Triad — Three essential fixes for dashboard viability
hyperedges.description: Three critical fixes that together make the dashboard viable: use setWidget instead of overlay, guarantee cleanup via finally blocks, and keep dashboard inline in the command handler instead of a separate extension.

Orchestration Safety Parameter System (11 guardrails)
hyperedges.description: 11 interconnected safety guardrails added to composable-pipeline and index.ts to prevent empty-run failures. Includes: prompt truncation (8K cap with proportional split), output type contracts, escape clause scanning/rewriting (9 patterns), budget estimation with >60% warning, 4-signal exhaustion detection, per-agent bug reporting, fallback model retry, 200-word task cap, git-status artifact evidence, and hard gate on zero-file-change implementation runs.

hyperedges.label: Safety Features Covering HANDOFF.md Orchestration Bugs
hyperedges.description: New orchestration safety parameters directly address 4 of 7 HANDOFF.md issues: ISSUE-3 (verifier trusts text) via output contract + artifact evidence + hard gate + phase bug reporting; ISSUE-4 (tasks too large) via task cap + prompt truncation + budget estimation + escape clause scanning + exhaustion detection; ISSUE-5 (no artifact verification) via artifact evidence + hard gate; ISSUE-6 (subagent post-agent_end errors) via fallback model. ISSUE-1 (routing fights planner), ISSUE-2 (intake overrides user model), and ISSUE-7 (PT 5.5 false match) remain unaddressed by these safety additions.

hyperedges.label: Composable Pipeline Safety Architecture
hyperedges.description: The composable-pipeline shape integrates 8 safety guardrails through 4 functions and 2 constants: detectExhaustion (4-signal context check), scanEscapeClauses + rewriteEscapeClauses (9-pattern escape removal), buildExecutorPrompt (output type contracts + escape rewriting + ANTI-ESCAPE NOTE + guardrails), task-size cap (200 words), fallback model (deepseek-v4-pro).
